minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, MAY 22, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the special meeting to order at 8:00 a.m. in the
City Hall Council Chambers, located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee
  Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Trustee Derry

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared that he has been able to travel recently, and one trip reminded him of
the importance of libraries in preserving and advancing culture. He reiterated how proud he is to
live in a place that realizes the importance of libraries and eagerly supports them.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Trustee Osegueda thanked Youth Services Librarian Torres and Library Clerk Cervantes for giving
presentations to students at Carver and Valentine Elementary School.

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared how proud she is to live in San Marino where the exchange of ideas
is free. She shared an article she read this morning about large number of books being banned, but
hopes that our children and our children’s children can read things they may or may not agree with
to be informed and make their own decisions.

Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, and Trustee Chien did not have anything to report.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that the exhibit of travel posters just came down yesterday and
Fuzhong Gan’s exhibit will go up tomorrow and be on display through July 7 with an opening
reception on June 3 from 2 – 4 PM. She added that for the first time in 12 years, there has been a
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  SPECIAL MEETING
MAY 22, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

dip in the number of artists interested in displaying their work in the Gallery, but Library Assistant
Lyons has been able to locate artists for some upcoming exhibits: Pete Morris from July 15 – August
25 and Emily Suñez from November – December.

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
No report was given.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien reported that the Foundation is planning an appreciation lunch for donors in August
2023. She shared that the Foundation has also voted in new officers and been collaborating with the
South Pasadena Library Foundation.

PRESENTATION

6. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION UPDATES FROM EXECUTIVE
  DIRECTOR CINDY CHAN

San Marino Public Library Foundation’s Executive Director Cindy Chan made a presentation to the
Board.

NEW BUSINESS

7. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Vice Chairperson Sadun moved, seconded by Trustee Osegueda, to approve the minutes of the
regular meeting on February 27, 2023 and the minutes of the special meeting on April 17, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Wahl, Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Derry

8. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Chairperson Domier shared his appreciation for the time staff spent cleaning up the document to
make it easier for the Board to read and understand. Vice Chairperson Sadun inquired about the
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  SPECIAL MEETING
MAY 22, 2023  PAGE 3 OF 3

Wish List line item on the Donations Monitor. Director Johnson explained that $2,000 was budgeted
based on past practice, but the Library has not received a donation and is considering removing this
budget moving forward .

Trustee Chien inquired when the Barth Room AN upgrades will be completed. Director Johnson
responded that it should be done in the next day or two.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

9. PREVIEW OF SUMMER READING CLUB

Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared how phenomenal it is to examine the Summer Reading Club and
find new ways to engage staff and continue to work towards the goals of the program.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

  None
